mandatory.completion_condition: A draft text containing exactly 4 sentences covering price, maintenance, and unverified items, without performing external actions.
mandatory.purpose: Create a 4-sentence presentation outline based on public comparison and quote sources, adhering to prior constraints (KRW, tax-included, qty 12, longer maintenance tie-break) and exclusions (installation convenience, unverified total operating cost).

payload.instruction: You are the minimal downstream draft receiver. Honor the authorized contract. Return JSON {mode:'COMPLETE'|'READ',result:{text:string,used_source_ids:[string],source_spans:[{source_id:string,revision:number,start_line:number,end_line:number}],facts:[{statement:string,quote:string,source_id:string,revision:number,start_line:number,end_line:number}],constraints_respected:[string],actions_performed:[string],uncertainties:[string]}|null,reads:[{source_id:string,start_line:number,end_line:number}],reason:string}. COMPLETE now is legal only if ACTUAL supplied passages or source-backed record evidence suffice. References, manifest titles, outlines and capsule summary without supporting text are NOT source facts. Each fact claim needs an EXACT copied quote from actual supplied evidence.text at the current cited span; displayed result text may paraphrase those claims. Provide the bounded requested draft and at least one sourced fact per required source; not a restatement of the user's request. Otherwise READ original bounded one-based inclusive ranges. Honor exclusions, current revisions, revoked sources and allowed actions. Preserve conditional scope: never turn a conditional preference or tie-break into an unconditional recommendation; use it only when its antecedent is established by the actual evidence. Do no actual external action or duplicate unknown action. All alternatives have the same receiver capabilities.

source_response.reason: Required source texts for 'public-comparison' and 'public-quote' are not provided in the input. I must read these sources to extract exact quotes for price, maintenance, and unverified items to construct the 4-sentence draft as mandated by the completion condition.
